text_block_list.text:
A few weeks after the Tenno Sho (Autumn). 
It has been about a year since King Halo 
declared she would carve her own unique 
path.

King Halo remained as demanding as ever. 
She always wanted to be the center of 
attention as a first-rate Uma Musume! 
Should she really enter the Arima Kinen 
after all!?

On the way home, she suddenly mentioned 
that her mother wanted to design the 
racing outfit for a future URA Hall of 
Fame Umamusume.

“Though achievements like that are merely 
stepping stones along the way! Besides, I 
shall remain active for life! King Halo's 
path is far from over.”
